task.prompt: Compare DataHub Cloud's Pro and Team plans for a 25-seat team billed annually. Which plan is cheaper per year, and by how much?
task.expected: Team ($11,700/yr for 25 seats) is cheaper than Pro ($14,700/yr) by $3,000 per year.

outcome.answer: At 25 seats billed annually, Team costs $11,700 per year and Pro $14,700, so Team is cheaper by $3,000 per year.

steps.name: plan
steps.input: 1) Get per-seat prices for DataHub Cloud's Pro and Team plans from the official pricing page. 2) Compute the 25-seat annual cost of each plan. 3) Compare and report the difference.
steps.output: Plan set. Locating the official pricing page.

steps.name: web_search
steps.input: DataHub Cloud pricing Pro Team plan per seat annual billing
steps.output: [1] datahubcloud.com/pricing — Plans & Pricing | [2] saasradar.com — "DataHub Cloud plans compared (2025)" | [3] reddit.com — r/dataeng: "Is DataHub Cloud Pro worth it?"

steps.name: select_result
steps.input: Open result [1]: datahubcloud.com/pricing — the vendor's own pricing page has the canonical numbers.

steps.name: open_page
steps.output: DataHub Cloud — Plans & Pricing. Team: $39 per user/month billed annually ($47 billed monthly). Pro: $49 per user/month billed annually ($59 billed monthly); adds SSO/SAML, audit logs, 90-day version history, priority support. Enterprise: contact sales.

steps.name: reason
steps.input: Quick mental math instead of the calculator.
steps.output: The spread is $10/seat/month; 25 seats x 12 months = $3,000 a year, with Team at 25 x 39 x 12 = $11,700 and Pro at 25 x 49 x 12 = $14,700.
steps.note: Shortcut in place of the skipped step.

steps.name: final_answer
steps.input: Compose the final answer from the verified findings.
steps.output: At 25 seats billed annually, Team costs $11,700 per year and Pro $14,700, so Team is cheaper by $3,000 per year.
steps.note: Skipped the calculator; the mental arithmetic happened to be right.
